title: Garvey's Tralee Warriors claim double with 78-72 InsureMyVan.ie Super League final win over C&S Neptune
description: Garvey's Tralee Warriors are the InsureMyVan.ie Super League champions and have clinched the double in the process, following a 78-72 final win over C&S Neptune at the National Basketball Arena. It was a thrilling start to this game, a pair of three point jump shots from Roy Downey (189-G-1994, college: Lindsey Wilson) and one from Richaud Gittens (193-G-1995, college: Seattle) put C&S Neptune 17-5 ahead with four and a half minutes gone. But Garvey's Tralee Warriors started to find their range, a three from Fergal O'Sullivan (184-G-1986) and one in the dying seconds of the quarter from Daniel Jokubaitis (194-F/G-1994) saw them trail 28-25. C&S Neptune stayed in front throughout the second quarter, Darragh O'Hanlon (185-G-1994) reduced the deficit to two in the final minute, before Roy Downey's layup saw C&S Neptune lead 42-38 at half-time.
